rationale: PINS the G8 gap + the SCD1 write gate (M37 #598): field READS (h.value, both in inc's RHS and read's body) USE the receiver h; assignment LHS (h.value = ..., h.value += ...) is a WRITE and must NOT emit. The original pin predated the JAD1/KAD1 family contract and pinned the write-as-read defect ('reads AND writes') — re-authored to the corrected contract like groovy's array-access-uses and kotlin's indexing-uses. The += compound-assign form parses as infix_expression (unlike =, which is assignment_expression) and is gated only for compound-assign ops so binary + is untouched. Repeated reads in one function dedupe to one edge.
